description: This Java source file defines a utility Android IntentService named UtilityService, used for handling background operations such as clearing notifications, and communicating with wearable devices via Google Play Services API. It includes static methods for triggering specific actions and internal methods for executing those actions, including network communication with connected wearables.

classes.name: UtilityService
classes.description: An Android IntentService for performing asynchronous background tasks related to notifications and wearable device communication.

methods.name: clearNotification
methods.description: Static method to start an intent to clear local notifications.

methods.name: clearRemoteNotifications
methods.description: Static method to initiate clearing notifications on remote devices via an intent.

methods.name: getClearRemoteNotificationsIntent
methods.description: Returns an intent configured to instruct remote devices to clear notifications.

methods.name: startDeviceActivity
methods.description: Static method to send a message to start a device activity with a specific path and attraction info.

methods.name: onHandleIntent
methods.description: Handles incoming intents and dispatches to appropriate internal methods based on the action.

methods.name: clearNotificationInternal
methods.description: Clears the local notification using NotificationManager.

methods.name: clearRemoteNotificationsInternal
methods.description: Communicates with all connected wearable nodes to clear notifications.

methods.name: startDeviceActivityInternal
methods.description: Sends a message to connected wearables to start a specific activity based on the provided path and info.
